android_mechanism: Progress broadcast emitted on every update; fix emits only when the value actually changes
bug_description: AVPlayerUtils' timeUpdate callback writes the millisecond-precision playback position into the global PLAY_TIME AppStorage state on every callback (about 10 times per second). The full player page binds PLAY_TIME via @StorageProp, so the heavy player view (cover art, controls, lyrics entry) re-renders at callback frequency even though the displayed progress only changes once per second, wasting UI-thread CPU during playback and draining battery.
fix_summary: The global state is written only when the whole-second part of the position changes (seek still updates immediately).

test_oracle.definition: raw-instruction-retired sample count attributed to the app process during the measured step, aggregated from perf.data (HapRay perf.db instruction counts).
test_oracle.comparison: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed over >= 3 rounds per variant

mechanism_oracle.definition: Count of player-page state-update/render passes attributable to PLAY_TIME changes during 60s of idle playback (ace trace component update events or JS state-set calls), plus UI-thread CPU time.
mechanism_oracle.comparison: unfixed ~600 state writes/minute (10/s); fixed ~60/minute (1/s). unfixed UI CPU time > fixed by a clearly measurable margin during playback.

reproduction: git -C hosts/cloudmusic checkout case/cloudmusic_play_time_high_frequency_update/unfixed; apply the measurement harness patch for this case, build, sign and install the HAP.
git -C hosts/cloudmusic checkout case/cloudmusic_play_time_high_frequency_update/fixed; rebuild, reinstall and repeat identically.
Compare test_oracle.metric across the two report sets: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed.
